title: Texture plate, lighting removed
description: Edit a plate so its lighting and shadows are removed, leaving flat colour (a texture plate).

body.subject: Edit this image: it shows {{subject}}.
body.action: Remove all lighting from it: every highlight, shadow, reflection and ambient occlusion, leaving only each surface's flat base colour.
body.camera: Keep the view, outline, position and scale exactly as in the image.
body.style: Flat albedo, even, no lighting, no shadows, no shading, no gloss.
body.constraints: Do not move, add, remove or redraw any shape; plain flat background; no text.

subject.default: an armour piece seen in orthographic view

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: silhouette IoU against the clay render / the V3 alpha (texlib/fidelity.py)

provenance.source: new, from the 'texture plates' idea: GPT 2.5 edits that remove lighting
